landing.body: Adept tracks AI research and job-market signals, matches you to future roles and builds a step-by-step learning plan linked to the UN Goals.
landing.step1Body: Upload a CV or pick from our skill bank.
landing.step2Body: See what is rising and declining, with sources.

landing.tStep2Body: Each person uploads a CV or picks skills; you see who is done.

landing.heroEyebrow: Career planning for the AI era
landing.heroNote: Your CV is read in memory and never stored
landing.startEyebrow: Try it now, no account needed
landing.startBody: No account needed. We show the skills we found, how they are trending and your best-fit future role. The rest unlocks with a free account.
landing.howTitleB: to a plan you can start this week.
landing.tHowTitleB: to one training plan for everyone.
landing.step1Detail: Upload your CV or choose from over 110 skills, then set your level for each. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.
landing.step2Detail: Your skills are compared with the latest AI research and labour-market data, so you can see which are growing in demand and which are seeing less demand (estimates).
landing.step3Detail: Roles are ranked by how well your skills fit, how fast their skills are growing and what interests you. Each score shows its parts and the skills you still need.
landing.step4Detail: Get courses in a clear order, sized to the hours you have each week. Free and HRD Corp-claimable options are marked, and each step shows the UN Goals it supports.
landing.tStep1Detail: Share one join code. People create a free account and enter the code, so there is no email list to manage.
landing.tStep2Detail: Each person uploads a CV or picks their skills in a few minutes. You see who has finished; CVs are never stored.
landing.tStep3Detail: A heatmap compares the skills each rising role needs with those of members who choose to share, and suggests the role where the team’s gap is largest.
landing.tStep4Detail: Give the team an ordered plan for the chosen role, then confirm each completion before it counts.
landing.explainBody: Each score is broken into parts you can read. Every trend shows its source and date, and every prediction is labelled as an estimate.
landing.explain1: See the skills behind every match
landing.explain2: Compare a moderate and a fast AI scenario
landing.faqBody: How we use data and AI
landing.a1: A free future-skills workspace. It connects the skills you have today to roles that are rising in the AI era, and to a learning plan you can follow at your own pace.
landing.q2: Do I need to know my next career move?
landing.a2: No. Start with your skills and interests, compare the roles we suggest, read the reasons behind each score and choose your own target.
landing.q3: Where do the trends come from?
landing.a3: From public sources: AI research papers (arXiv) and official labour-market projections. Every trend shows its source and the date of the snapshot it comes from.
landing.a4: No. Outlooks are estimates under a moderate and a fast AI scenario. They help you plan; they are not promises of a job.
landing.a5: The CV file is parsed in memory and is not stored. Only confirmed skills are saved. When optional AI skill matching is enabled, short redacted skill phrases may be sent to the disclosed provider; see Privacy.
landing.a6: Yes. A manager or career advisor creates a workspace, shares a join code, sees the team’s skill gaps and assigns one training plan. Members keep control of their own data.
landing.footTag: A clearer direction. A future you can build.
landing.footHuman: People decide. Adept never makes hiring decisions.

landing.vRoles: {count, plural, one {# future role} other {# future roles}} ranked for you

landing.featBody: Six parts, one journey. Each works from the same public data, with its source and date.
landing.tFeatBody: From one join code to one training plan, with reviews and impact you can report.
landing.f1Body: Upload a CV and we find your skills in our skill bank. You confirm every one.
landing.f2Body: Which of your skills are rising or declining, estimated from AI research and labour-market data.
landing.f3Body: Future roles ranked by skill overlap, trend outlook and interest, with every gap listed.
landing.f4Body: Compare a moderate and a fast pace of AI change. Every outlook is labelled an estimate.
landing.f5Body: Ordered free and HRD Corp-claimable courses that fit the hours you have each week.
landing.f6Body: See which UN Sustainable Development Goals each role and step of your path supports.
landing.tf1Body: Share one code. See who has joined and who has finished their skills profile, without chasing emails.
landing.tf2Body: Skill gaps against each rising role, for members who choose to share, so the biggest gaps stand out at a glance.
landing.tf3Body: Adept starts with the role closest to the team’s existing skills. Choose a learning goal, compare packages and send a proposal.
landing.tf4Body: Ordered courses for the chosen role, showing which members each step applies to.
landing.tf5Body: Courses your organisation can claim under its training levy are marked, with the source and date.
landing.tf6Body: Members add proof of completion. You confirm it before it counts, with a note back if needed.
landing.forTeamEyebrow: For HR, L&D and career centres
landing.autoplay: Steps advance on their own until you choose one.
landing.sSkills: estimated from AI research and labour-market data
landing.sHrd: courses out of {total} in the catalogue
landing.sGoals: by the future roles we recommend
landing.ta1: You share a join code. Each person creates a free account, enters the code and completes a short skills profile. No email lists or file imports.
landing.ta2: Who has finished their profile and, for members who choose to share, each member’s skill gaps against the target role and the group plan. CVs are read in memory and never stored.
landing.tq3: Can we use HRD Corp funding?
landing.ta3: Courses marked HRD Corp-claimable can be applied for under your organisation’s training levy. Each flag shows its source and the date it was checked.
landing.tq4: Does Adept make hiring or promotion decisions?
landing.ta4: No. Adept shows skills, gaps and estimates to support your people’s own decisions. It never ranks employees for hiring, promotion or exit.
landing.tq5: Does it work for universities and TVET centres?
landing.ta5: Yes. Choose institution at set-up: advisors get the same cohort view with a join code, skill gaps, a group plan and completion reviews.
